The '''K-Series spaceport control droid''' was a model of [[Controller droid/Legends|spaceport control droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].

==Characteristics==
Tall and awkward-looking, with a dome-shaped head<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> and a slightly-protruding mid-section,<ref name="Tramp Freighter" /> the [[Class three droid/Legends|third-degree]] K-Series [[Controller droid/Legends|spaceport control droid]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> was a typical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of its class. Standing 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height, it had a [[Humanoid/Legends|human]] body, with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]],<ref name="Tramp Freighter" /> both tipped with a hand appendage,<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> and two legs. Painted [[Color/Legends|bright red]],<ref name="Tramp Freighter" /> K-Series droids stood out in crowds. They were equipped with a pair of [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual]] and [[Audio sensor/Legends|auditory]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[recorder]], as well as a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] speech/sound system. Possessing a basic [[Processor/Legends|processor]], K-Series droids were equipped with a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

An [[Administrative droid/Legends|administrative droid]], the K-Series handled [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic control and other logistical details of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and was the first line of communication between [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and spaceport control. It sent automated messages to approaching and departing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and handled most of the menial, low-level tasks of spaceport control. K-Series droids were skilled and meticulous, and they took their duties very seriously. They were capable of speaking multiple [[Language/Legends|languages]], including [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Binary/Legends|Binary]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]], and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

==History==
Manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], the availability of K-Series spaceport control droid was licensed, and they cost 5,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> or 1,500 credits used.<ref name="Tramp Freighter" /> They were rarely seen, but often heard, in spaceports throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

A modified K-Series spaceport control droid, [[K-M2]] was the result of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] experiment in using droids to penetrate the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at vital points. He rose to take over [[Travnin Spaceport|spaceport control]] on [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]], in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="Tramp Freighter" />

[[M-3PO (Emtrey)/Legends|M-3PO]], known as Emtrey, was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that served as [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] from around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Emtrey was refitted by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] named [[Losca]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and was fitted with a head from a spaceport control droid.
